Route: routes/api.js mounted at /api (also /apiV2, /apiSa, /apiSaV2, /internal-api) behind verifyEmbedRequest/swagger token, handlers/api.js:89-101.
1. POST /api/shop/field-number (shopController.js:168-172) increments a client-named field: {field:'isUseGPT5'} or {field:'plan'} unlocks paid features. Allow-list: only 'isYoutubeSlotActive' (sole FE caller SettingGenAiYouTube.jsx:183 — confirm by grep); 400 otherwise.
2. config/pickFields.js:87-94 blockFields misses the legacy entitlement flags hasFeature() reads (config/subscription/grantedFeatures.js:31-34): isUseGPT5, isUnLockLimitAI, unLimitToolYoutube, isUnlimitedAnalytics. Derive them from GRANTABLE_FEATURES legacyFlag so new flags can't drift, and add them to blockFields. Check DevZone still sets them through its own path.
3. helpers/helpers.js:21-28 prepareShop returns googleAnalytics.serviceAccountKey (full SA JSON incl. private_key) via GET /api/shop, bootstrap payload, POST /shop response, subscriptionController.js:50. FE only needs client_email (Analytics/index.jsx:54-57,220-224). Return {projectId, propertyId, clientEmail, isConfigured} without serviceAccountKey; update the FE to read clientEmail / isConfigured.
4. repositories/shopRepository.js:116 console.logs JSON.stringify(postData) on every update: log shopID + Object.keys(postData) only, via the repo logger.

HARD RULE for packages/functions: never `await import(...)` a local module — .babelrc keeps import() native and prod throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (jest hides it); lazy-load with require(). Keep each fix minimal and do not refactor beyond it. If a fix would break a legit caller you find, keep the caller working and say so.
